verdict.rationale: The public API documents issuing virtual cards (VCN) with a limit value you send, updating them to raise the ceiling, change the time window and adjust controls, and blocking or unblocking corporate cards. Together these cover create, lock and update controls. Missing for 10: API issuance of standard corporate cards (only VCNs are shown being created), evidence that VCNs can be locked rather than only cancelled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue and manage cards programmatically — create a card with a limit, lock it, update controls — via the public API

citations.quote: Issue, look up, top up, reveal and cancel virtual cards (VCN) for travel bookings (hotel and air) and uses you define.
CUSTOM a use you define, e.g. one card per supplier reference the limit.value you send
List, block, and unblock corporate cards.
For CUSTOM, Update VCN tops up the ceiling, extends or shortens the window and adjusts the controls, without replacing the card.
